{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Count rows with customer_age == -1
missing_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {missing_age_count}")

# Count valid age entries (excluding -1)
valid_age_count = len(df[df['customer_age'] != -1])
print(f"Number of valid customer_age entries (excluding -1): {valid_age_count}")

# Compute mean age of valid entries
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of valid entries: {mean_age}")

# Round to two decimal places for final answer
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)
print(f"Rounded mean age: {mean_age_rounded}")"}
